Container.Name: hako
Container.Overview: Hako - anonymous temporary file sharing. Files are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and deleted automatically at expiry. Download links are unguessable random tokens, uploaded files are never served back as a type the browser will execute, IP addresses are stored only as keyed HMAC digests, and uploads are size-capped as they stream. IMPORTANT - the container runs as an unprivileged user (uid/gid 10001), not root. The appdata paths below are bind mounts, so Unraid will create them owned by root and Hako will not be able to write. Before first start, run this once from a terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/hako/{data,uploads,images} && chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/hako Set an Encryption Key as well - leaving it blank starts Hako on a publicly known placeholder key and shows a warning banner in the web UI.

Config.Name: Database Storage
Config.Description: SQLite database storage location. Must be owned by uid 10001 - see Overview.

Config.Name: Upload Storage
Config.Description: Encrypted file upload storage location. Must be owned by uid 10001 - see Overview.

Config.Name: Image Storage
Config.Description: AVIF character images storage (optional). Must be readable by uid 10001 - see Overview.

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: 32-character encryption key for AES-256-GCM. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 24 - that is exactly 32 characters, with nothing truncated. Anything shorter is refused at startup; blank falls back to a publicly known placeholder key and warns. Changing it later makes existing uploads permanently undecryptable.

Config.Name: Rust Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level (trace, debug, info, warn, error)

Config.Name: Max File Size (MB)
Config.Description: Maximum upload file size in megabytes

Config.Name: File Expiry (Minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes until uploaded files expire and are deleted

Config.Name: Cleanup Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: How often to check for expired files (seconds)

Config.Name: Access Log Retention (Days)
Config.Description: Days to retain access logs before deletion

Config.Name: Actix Workers
Config.Description: Number of worker threads (defaults to CPU count)

Config.Name: Base URL (Production)
Config.Description: Production domain for CORS restriction (e.g., https://yourdomain.com)
